theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, ne_bot⟩ := v
  have h1 : p ≠ ⊥ := ne_bot
  have h2 : p.IsPrime := hp
  have h3 : p ≠ ⊤ := by contrapose! h2; exact Ideal.isPrincipal_iff_eq_ideal_one.mp (Ideal.isPrincipal_iff_eq_ideal_one.mpr h2)
  have h4 : Ideal.absNorm p = Ideal.norm p := by rw [Ideal.absNorm_def, Ideal.norm_eq_abs]
  have h5 : Ideal.norm p ≠ 0 := by rw [Ideal.norm_zero]; exact not_le_zero (Ideal.norm_nonneg _)
  have h6 : Ideal.norm p = Ideal.radical (Ideal.pow p 1) := by rw [Ideal.norm_eq_radical]
  have h7 : Ideal.radical (Ideal.pow p 1) = p := by rw [Ideal.radical_ideals_pow, Ideal.radical_idempotent]
  have h8 : Ideal.norm p = Ideal.norm p := by rw [h6, h7]
  have h9 : Ideal.norm p = Ideal.norm p := by rw [h8]
  have h10 : Ideal.norm p = 1 := by rw [Ideal.norm_one]
  contradiction
